coder_notes: Solid-tumour basket restricted to IDH1 R132-mutant tumours (IDH2 for cholangiocarcinoma). Glioblastoma is named only in keywords, not in conditions, title or inclusion criteria (C7); conditions list 'Glioma' only, and enrolment requires IDH mutation, i.e. IDH-mutant glioma only -> not_glioblastoma. Primary CNS tumours allowed (eligibility item placed under exclusion list). Regimen coded combination because the expansion arm includes combinations with gemcitabine + cisplatin or durvalumab; dose-escalation and three expansion cohorts are LY3410738 monotherapy. Gemcitabine + cisplatin treated as first-line cholangiocarcinoma standard backbone. Lead sponsor Eli Lilly (industry; [CODE]).
